index.title: Famous glazes
index.lead: Glazes known around the world, each from its traditional local materials, with its unity formula and a version from the materials sold where you are.
index.more: More glazes are coming: each is added once its recipe and materials rest on at least three sources that were read.

glaze.lead: A famous glaze ({native}): its traditional recipe or analysis, its firing, and a version from the materials sold where you are.
glaze.historyOnly: History only: this glaze was made with lead. Its analysis is shown as history, not as a recipe to mix. The version below is a different glaze, without lead.

local.heading: With your local materials
local.intro: The traditional recipe's unity formula, made from the standard materials sold where you buy. Choose where you buy to see it.
local.testFirst: Fire test tiles before you use it on any ware, and test a food surface for leaching.
local.untestedNote: Calculated, not yet test-fired: fire test tiles before use.
local.close: It comes close to the target formula.
local.fair: It comes fairly close to the target formula.
local.poor: These materials cannot come close to the target formula.
local.none: The materials sold there cannot make it.
local.choose: Choose where you buy materials to see it made from those sold there.
